titulo: Mago: folha idle (refazer no desenho aprovado)
prompt: 2D game sprite sheet, transparent PNG background (real alpha, NOT a checkerboard pattern, NOT white), hand-painted ARPG style with a consistent dark 2-3 px outline, light from top-left, no pixel art, no glow bleeding outside the cell. Character: EXACTLY the same Mage as in attached images 1 and 2 (approved design, keep identical): young boy with messy brown hair and normal brown/blue eyes (NO glowing eyes), deep NAVY-BLUE hood and long navy coat with gold trim and gold star/compass embroidery, navy scarf, white sleeves under brown leather gloves, brown leather belt with a gold-buckled book pouch, brown boots, ornate GOLDEN staff with a gold ring at the top holding a glowing BLUE crystal with small floating crystal shards (NEVER a plain wooden staff, NEVER purple robe, NEVER a lantern). Chibi proportions, about 3 heads tall, same scale, colors and painting as image 2 (frames of the same character). Sheet layout: grid with 6 columns (animation frames, left to right) and 5 rows (directions top to bottom: row 1 facing DOWN toward the camera, row 2 facing down-right, row 3 facing right, row 4 facing up-right, row 5 facing UP away from the camera; left directions are mirrored by the game, do not draw them). Leave clear empty space between cells so no frame touches another; feet of every frame on the same baseline of its row, same character size in every cell. IDLE loop, 6 frames: calm standing pose, staff upright in the right hand, gentle breathing (chest rises), scarf and coat hem sway, crystal pulses softly. Eyes open, calm expression.
